# Arrange resource access

Identify each required resource, minimum capability, accountable grantor and
approved request route. Shared policies belong in the plan. Person-specific
requests use the existing access kind and actual declared resource section
instances. Do not grant blanket privileges or treat a catalog identity as a
generated repeated instance. Keep independent requests distinct when useful.

Use stable unique ids. Arranged needs a known accountable owner and a nonsecret
resource or request reference. Helpers are optional for access. Pending,
requested and deferred may show missing details, while supplied unknown
contacts or sections are invalid. Targets are optional real planning dates.
Never put credentials, private tokens or secret request links in preparation.

Confirm how the newcomer will safely verify the intended capability and who
handles refusal or excessive permissions. A request, membership or arranged
status does not prove use of the resource. No preparation status grants
authorization, verifies access or changes the newcomer-owned record.
